scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(!ua.includes('pnpm')){console.error('Use pnpm instead');process.exit(1)};for(const f of['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']){try{fs.unlinkSync(f)}catch(e){if(e.code!=='ENOENT')throw e}}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
